passive.name: Night Hunter
passive.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

spells.name: Tumble
spells.description: Vayne rolls a short distance, and deals an additional physical damage on her next Attack. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation ADRatioBonus was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Silver Bolts
spells.description: Passive: Every third consecutive Attack or Ability against an enemy deals an additional max Health true damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Condemn
spells.description: Vayne fires a bolt that Knocks Back and deals physical damage. If the target collides with terrain, they take bonus physical damage and become Stunned for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
